intro: Technology and cybersecurity organizations bore the brunt of the 67 incidents tracked under ai-security between April 12 and August 6, with critical infrastructure, government, and financial services also heavily affected across global, United States, China, and North America regions. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed in these campaigns, which leveraged vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 7.7), and CVE-2026-45303 (CVSS 7.7). The reporting mix comprised 32 high-severity, 9 critical, 14 informational, and 6 medium-severity items.
